title: Extract network rerun row projection
summary: Extract the read-only Network CSV rerun row projection helpers from the oversized rerun results orchestration module into a focused process-domain child module without changing payloads or imports.
reason: The rerun results queue projection module mixes local manifest orchestration with Network row normalization, output evidence formatting, and lifecycle aggregation. Isolating the read-only projection seam reduces retrieval cost and maintenance coupling while leaving network claims, lifecycle decisions, persistence, and mutation ownership unchanged.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun row keys, reducer and worker evidence, output probe evidence, lifecycle counts, and Queue row dictionaries are produced inside rerun_results_queue_projection.py.
behavior_after: The same Network CSV rerun row payloads and import surface are produced through a focused rerun_results_network_projection.py child while rerun_results_queue_projection.py retains manifest scanning, runtime correlation, and payload orchestration.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_rerun_results_network_projection.py: 8 focused tests cover the child export surface, stable row keys, defensive evidence copies, verified-output precedence, bounded output probing, lifecycle counts, full Queue-row projection, input immutability, and preserved parent helper identities.
tests/python/desktop/test_process_rerun_results.py: retargeted the bounded output-probe mock to the extracted helper owner while preserving the existing 38-test behavior suite.
